title: A submessage without its required `format`

source.clause: §5.2.2 ("The format field is required and is a string")
source.note: composed: negative case for §5.2.2 at a submessage path, where 08-missing-format covers the first submessage.

notes: The path is what the case is for: a message whose second submessage is malformed must say which one, or a peer debugging a long exchange has to bisect it.
